rule: Each suggestion states the problem, the options, a recommendation, cost, risk and what blocks it, so a reviewer can choose a path before anything is implemented.

suggestions.title: Fix the stale standings rows and the unplayed-result fixture
suggestions.problem: 10 field differences in data/verified/standings_2026.csv and the WAS @ NYG fixture still listed as upcoming.
options: A: refresh the committed standings from the official page and re-run every generator that reads them (correct, larger blast radius)
B: leave the file frozen with a dated stamp and publish the difference (safe, keeps published numbers stale)
C: freeze only the disputed rows and refresh the rest (not recommended: mixes vintages in one table)
suggestions.recommendation: A, executed as its own task with a fresh official fetch, then B as a permanent 'as-of' stamp on every table.

suggestions.title: Re-pin the games.csv provenance hash
suggestions.problem: provenance.json records 2,190,032 bytes / 50939c24d43e..., the file is 1,665,522 bytes / 483beddbdf22....
options: A: re-download in Actions and re-pin (restores a real integrity claim)
B: re-pin the current file (honest hash, weaker claim)
C: drop the sha256 field (stops the false claim, loses the check)
suggestions.recommendation: A, because the whole repository rests on pinned provenance; B is acceptable as an interim.

suggestions.title: Add an 'as-of' timestamp to every published table
suggestions.problem: Tables show a build time but not the time of the official data, so a stale row looks live.
options: A: per-table 'official data as of' stamp
B: one site-wide stamp
C: no stamp, rely on the Flags page
suggestions.recommendation: A: the reader can then tell a stale row from a wrong one without reading the flags.

suggestions.title: Buy or build a timestamped odds history before any edge work continues
suggestions.problem: No bettable price series exists; the consensus closing line cannot be transacted.
options: A: licensed historical odds vendor
B: scrape a book (terms-of-service risk)
C: stay consensus-only and never claim bettable profit
suggestions.recommendation: A, and until then publish C explicitly so no number is mistaken for a realisable return.

suggestions.title: Publish a per-game inactive list for 2026 so depth signals can be measured
suggestions.problem: The injury report is a weekly snapshot, not the game-day inactive list, so 2nd/3rd-string effects cannot be scored.
options: A: add the official per-game inactives to the collector
B: use the weekly report with an explicit accuracy caveat
C: leave injury effects out of the model
suggestions.recommendation: A; B is acceptable only if the model keeps saying the effect is unmeasured.

suggestions.title: Keep the negative result and stop searching for a schedule edge
suggestions.problem: 0 of 11 rules pass; searching harder after seeing the data is how false positives are made.
options: A: publish the negative result and freeze the rule set
B: keep adding rules until one passes
C: change the threshold on the best rule until it passes
suggestions.recommendation: A. B and C are what the Benjamini-Hochberg gate and the pre-registration hash exist to prevent. If new rules are wanted they must be registered before the next evaluation.

suggestions.title: Give the leaderboard rewards that are not money
suggestions.problem: The brief asks for rewards for top-performing strategies; paying for picks raises legal exposure.
options: A: non-monetary badges (Verified Signal, Top Single Bet)
B: internal scoring only
C: cash prizes (needs legal review in every jurisdiction)
suggestions.recommendation: A now, C only with written legal advice; this study's leaderboard is empty so no reward is live.

suggestions.title: Consolidate the five site generations into one navigable site
suggestions.problem: Root, pages/, docs/, lab/, dashboard/, verified-lab/ and research/ all publish overlapping pages.
options: A: one landing page linking every category (this study's approach)
B: delete the older generations (loses evidence)
C: leave them all and hope the reader finds the right one
suggestions.recommendation: A: additive, nothing is lost, and the All Sections page keeps every page reachable.
